proposed_requirements.title: SEC-03 Supplier accountability for security: The supplier must name an accountable security owner and maintain a current inventory of controls and assets supporting the assessed service

source.quote:
SEC-03 — Severity: Medium. Supplier accountability for security.

The supplier must name an accountable security owner and maintain a current inventory of controls and assets supporting the assessed service.

proposed_requirements.title: SEC-01 Identity and privileged access: For relationships with privileged access, the supplier must enable MFA for every privileged account, including supplier support accounts accessing Northstar systems or the assessed service

source.quote:
SEC-01 — Severity: High. Applies when privileged access is present.

For relationships with privileged access, the supplier must enable MFA for every privileged account, including supplier support accounts accessing Northstar systems or the assessed service.

proposed_requirements.title: SEC-04 Privileged access lifecycle: For relationships with privileged access, supplier personnel must receive approved least-privilege access and have that access revoked promptly when their duties change or end

source.quote:
SEC-04 — Severity: High. Applies when privileged access is present.

For relationships with privileged access, supplier personnel must receive approved least-privilege access and have that access revoked promptly when their duties change or end.

proposed_requirements.title: SEC-02 Data protection and keys: For relationships processing personal data, the supplier must keep Northstar data encrypted at rest across production storage, replicas, logs and backups

source.quote:
SEC-02 — Severity: High. Applies when personal data is processed.

For relationships processing personal data, the supplier must keep Northstar data encrypted at rest across production storage, replicas, logs and backups.

proposed_requirements.title: SEC-05 Vulnerabilities, development and change: The supplier must operate a documented vulnerability and patch process that prioritizes remediation using severity, exposure and service impact, including testing, change approval and tracked exceptions

source.quote:
SEC-05 — Severity: High. Vulnerability management.

The supplier must operate a documented vulnerability and patch process that prioritizes remediation using severity, exposure and service impact, including testing, change approval and tracked exceptions.

proposed_requirements.title: SEC-06 Independent assurance and recovery context: For high-criticality services, the supplier must provide current independent assurance evidence identifying the assessed service, covered controls, review period and material exclusions

source.quote:
SEC-06 — Severity: Medium. Applies when business criticality is high.

For high-criticality services, the supplier must provide current independent assurance evidence identifying the assessed service, covered controls, review period and material exclusions.

proposed_requirements.title: Signed DPA requirement for personal data processing

source.quote: For relationships processing personal data, the supplier must have a signed DPA with Northstar before processing begins.

proposed_requirements.title: Process Northstar data only for documented purposes

source.quote: For relationships processing personal data, the supplier must process Northstar data only for documented purposes and minimize the data used to what those purposes need.

proposed_requirements.title: Primary hosting and processing in the EU

source.quote: For relationships processing personal data, the supplier must keep primary hosting and processing for the assessed service in the EU.

proposed_requirements.title: Maintain subprocessor inventory and give advance notice of changes

source.quote: For relationships processing personal data, the supplier must maintain a current subprocessor inventory and give Northstar advance notice of changes so Privacy can review access scope and transfer safeguards.

proposed_requirements.title: Complete deletion within 30 calendar days after service termination or authenticated deletion request

source.quote: For relationships processing personal data, the supplier must complete deletion of Northstar personal data within 30 calendar days after service termination or an authenticated deletion request, excluding documented preservation obligations and technically isolated backup cycles.

proposed_requirements.title: Support individual rights requests using agreed process

source.quote: For relationships processing personal data, the supplier must support Northstar with access, correction, deletion and export requests using the agreed authenticated request process.

proposed_requirements.title: Supplier relationship accountability

source.quote: The supplier must name an accountable relationship owner and provide a maintained contact and escalation route for the assessed service.

proposed_requirements.title: Assurance response quality

source.quote: The supplier must provide accurate assurance responses with dated supporting evidence that identifies the assessed service, coverage period and known limitations.

proposed_requirements.title: Contractual flow-down

source.quote: The supplier must flow down the applicable Northstar service obligations to subcontractors performing those activities and retain accountability for their delivery.

proposed_requirements.title: Continuity and exit plan maintenance for high business criticality services

source.quote: For high-criticality services, the supplier must maintain a continuity plan and a tested exit plan covering recovery dependencies, Northstar data return and transition responsibilities.

proposed_requirements.title: Supplier notification within 24 hours of incident awareness

source.quote: The supplier must notify Northstar within 24 calendar hours after becoming aware of a suspected or confirmed incident affecting Northstar data, systems, credentials or service delivery.

proposed_requirements.title: Preserve incident evidence and maintain a timestamped timeline

source.quote: The supplier must preserve relevant incident evidence and maintain a timestamped timeline of observations, containment actions and recovery decisions affecting Northstar.

proposed_requirements.title: Provide containment and recovery updates through closure

source.quote: The supplier must provide containment and recovery updates to Northstar through incident closure, including material changes to assessed impact and unresolved recovery risks.

proposed_requirements.title: Deliver a scoped root-cause and corrective-action report for confirmed incidents

source.quote: For confirmed incidents, the supplier must deliver a scoped root-cause and corrective-action report identifying contributing factors, accountable remediation owners and verification of closure.
